extra.final_summary: The data had two main issues affecting the analysis: (1) two rows with invalid flipper lengths (negative values -185 and -212 mm) were excluded as they violate the physical constraint of being below 170 mm; (2) two rows with extreme body mass values (4,450,000 g and 5,700,000 g) were excluded as they exceed the maximum allowed value of 6,500 g. Additionally, the 'sex' column had a case variant 'FEMALE' which was normalized to 'female'. After these fixes, the average body mass by species was calculated on 63 valid rows. The results are: Adelie: 3,687.5 g, Chinstrap: 3,726.7 g, Gentoo: 5,253.6 g.
